AI SOC Investigations You Can Trust

Conifers CognitiveSOC™ is your transparent AI SOC platform for contextual investigations.

We use your own institutional knowledge to investigate complex, multi-tier threats.

Every conclusion is backed by clear evidence and reasoning—so your team can act with confidence, work more effectively and efficiently, and increase investigation output per analyst.

Solving Enterprise & MSSP SOC Challenges​

We hear it every day:
Organizations are dissatisfied with their SOC security tools. ​

  • No visibility into my SOC’s impact on the business​

    Our strategic dashboard helps organizations understand and prove proactive risk reduction, and team efficiency and effectiveness.

  • One-size-fits-all doesn’t fit us​

    Conifers continuously ingests and adapts investigations based on your own data, historical behavior and risk tolerances​.

  • Repetitive tasks = analyst burnout

    Our robust feedback loop refines detections for higher ​accuracy and reduced noise.

  • Another new tool, another new distraction ​

    We work within your existing incident management system — no need for ”context switching.”​

Introducing the
CognitiveSOC™

Our AI SOC agents platform uses adaptive learning, deep understanding of your institutional knowledge, and a feedback loop to help SOC teams solve the multi-tier problems at scale.

And we do this with maximum accuracy, environmental awareness, and cost-effectiveness in an easy-to-deploy, non-disruptive solution.
